fact: Aqueous sucrose standards; example 5g sucrose plus 95g water for 5% by mass; stirred; RI checked using MyBrix; capped 100mL bottles; 0.22µm syringe filter into 1.5mL tubes; remeasure RI at each experiment start.
boundary: Exact mixing duration, filter membrane and rinse/carryover procedure unspecified.

locator: Main Methods optical measurements and PCA; main Results precision
fact: Eleven calibration solutions spanning approximately 0–5% sucrose and RI 1.3328–1.3403; transform speckle frames by PCA and linear PC1/reference-RI fit; unknowns are interpolation within calibration range.
boundary: No extrapolation or concentration prediction from unmatched wavelength reference.

locator: Main Methods chamber and Fig5; main Results protein paragraph
fact: Prebuilt PDMS chip has bubble trap, reversible vacuum chuck, inlet/outlet and SPP chamber; reported chamber sample volume 22µL but optically interrogated volume about 300pL; clamp inlet during transfer between sample tubes.
boundary: 22µL is chamber capacity, 300pL is optical interrogation region, neither is full required handling volume. Flow conflict blocks invented numeric pump settings.

locator: Main Fig1 and Methods optical measurements; SI 4.1–4.4 pp10–13
fact: Two cameras separate beam profile and speckle measurement. Diffuser is tape; laser wavelength and hardware geometry are calibrated service attributes. SI tests optical drift, position dependence, shot noise and dark frames.
boundary: No open-beam alignment or custom light-source construction in agent task.

fact: Experiment was not temperature controlled; thermistor on chamber monitored approximately ±50mK over ~30min run and ±5mK over ~30s precision measurement.
boundary: These are observed conditions, not validated controller tolerances or mandatory acceptance cutoffs.

locator: Main Results precision; SI Tables3–4 pp12–13
fact: Repeated readings estimate within-sample SD; 4–5 calibration/measurement runs generate 32–40 precision estimates. Averaged precision error is SEM across estimates.
physical_operations: repeat without relabeling as new independent sample
boundary: Source values are reference outcomes and may not be pass/fail thresholds.
